# Bazel 10.0.0-dzbarsky20261020

First date-based release on `dzbarsky-20.10.2026`, based on upstream `master`
(`a2cbc1f4b4`). The binary version uses Bazel's numeric version format.

Carries forward the applicable 9.4 fork patches, including cache probing,
`gencquery`, `genaquery`, repository cache and `repository_ctx.copy` support,
toolchain analysis reuse, and the remote file-write strategy. Patches already
included or superseded by upstream are omitted.

Also includes the latest 9.4 updates: write repository mappings as raw bytes,
reduce memory held by remote input uploads, share action-cache path strings,
and avoid propagating aspects to no-config dependencies.
